title: Pretty set and and very sharp
text: Pretty set and and very sharp. This set is more of a soft sea green than a blue.  Very pretty set.  It's very sharp. I've already cut myself with one of the knives.  It sliced through my finger nail very easily.  They are on the lightweight size and I don't know how long they will last, but as of now, I think they are a very nice set.  I don't think $55 is a great deal for them, but still a nice set.

product_metadata.title: Kenmore Kane Stainless Steel Forged Triple Riveted Cutlery Knife Block Set, 14-Piece, Glacier Blue
features: All in one: 14Piece includes essentials for all types of cutting; 8-inch chef's, 7-inch Santoku, 8-inch bread, 5-inch Utility, 3. 5-Inch Paring, six steak knives, kitchen shears, heavy rubber-coated wood block, and sharpener

description: The Kenmore Kane 14Piece stainless steel cutlery set includes all the essential knives You need for everyday cooking. Comes with a large chef’s, Paring, Santoku, utility, and bread knives as well as shears, six steak knives, sharpener and rubber-coated heavy wood block to store them— all in matching brilliant Glacier Blue. Made from single-piece, precision-forged stainless steel, The knives and tools in this set are designed to be sharpened and used for years to come. Sturdy ergonomic handles help safe, precise cutting. And everything stores securely in a matching storage block that looks great on your kitchen counter. Experience cutting edge performance with Kenmore Cooke 14Piece stainless steel cutlery set. Perfect for veteran chefs or others simply looking to expand their culinary palette, the Kenmore cook one-piece stainless steel cutlery set performs under pressure and delivers delicious results.
